description: PULPO is a Python package for optimising production and supply-chain choices against life-cycle impacts. It combines Brightway inventory models with Pyomo optimisation, letting users select technologies or regions, impose production-capacity and material constraints, and minimise environmental effects. Inputs are life-cycle inventories, characterisation factors, demands or supply volumes, and scenario limits; outputs are selected activities, impact values and constraint results. The spatial and temporal extent follows the chosen inventory; a time-indexed module also handles inter-period storage. Source is free under BSD-3-Clause with PyPI installation and example notebooks for methanol, hydrogen, electricity and plastics. A limitation is that results inherit the completeness and licences of the underlying inventories and require a compatible optimiser; economic and social indicators remain under development. This is useful for industrial material and energy-supply infrastructure planning. It is related to power-system optimisers but models life-cycle production choices, not grid physics. The notebooks were identified, not executed.
